verdict.rationale: Unleash documents scheduling a feature release for a specific date and time. Its release management offers templated rollout sequences and automated milestone progression based on metrics, which is a form of scheduled or automated workflow. None of this evidence describes recurring jobs or general-purpose workflow scheduling; it is limited to one-off, flag-centric timed or metric-driven rollouts. Missing for 10: recurring/cron-style scheduling, general workflow or job scheduling beyond feature flags, detailed docs on how scheduling is configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
